title: Industry Immersion
text: Industry Immersions are intensive, unpaid experiences lasting one to one-and-a-half weeks. Fellows explore civilian organizations aligned with their career goals while delivering real value. By shadowing executives and working with cross-functional teams, Fellows gain firsthand insight into leadership, culture, and operations—while host organizations experience the proven leadership and results-driven mindset Fellows bring from elite Special Operations service.

title: Executive Coaching
text: Executive Coaching delivers personalized, one-on-one guidance tailored to each Fellow’s transition and career objectives. Coaching builds confidence, sharpens focus, and accelerates entry into civilian roles. Support includes assessments, professional branding, interview preparation, networking strategy, and warm introductions—driving clarity and momentum toward meaningful career outcomes.

title: Strategic Networking
text: Strategic Networking equips Fellows to build intentional, high-value relationships in the civilian workforce. Through a structured, values-driven approach, Fellows expand their professional networks beyond military service. Curated roundtables, workshops, and small-group engagements with executive leaders provide insight into civilian career paths, workplace norms, and leadership expectations—building social capital, confidence, and context for successful transition.
